issues: No [services.*] blocks at all — postgres and redis are direct devservices/config.yml dependencies (shared-postgres, shared-redis) and should have been wired as native Flox services
postgresql and redis are not even installed in [install], so the env has no psql/redis-cli either

Kafka and ClickHouse (transitive via snuba) are never named; the only acknowledgement is a passing hook comment that 'devservices, migrations, createuser' are 'left to you' — closer to a silent drop than an explicit detected-but-unresolvable note
Service discovery appears to have been skipped rather than resolved through devservices/config.yml; the manifest reads as if only pin files and the Brewfile were inspected
python313.version = "python3-3.13.1" uses a suspect version-string format (expected "3.13.1")
Runtime pinning is exact and correct (python313 3.13.1 from .python-version, nodejs_24 24.14.0 from .node-version)
Monorepo handling is strong: uv + uv.lock for Python, pnpm@10.30.2 via corepack per packageManager, tools.fast_editable for the editable install
Idiomatic Flox usage is very good: $FLOX_ENV_CACHE for venv/corepack state, $FLOX_ENV for the interpreter, no absolute paths, no hallucinated install URLs

results.manifest_excerpt:
## Flox Environment Manifest -----------------------------------------
##
##   _Everything_ you need to know about the _manifest_ is here:
##
##   https://flox.dev/docs/reference/command-reference/manifest.toml/
##
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify


## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
# Runtimes — versions pinned to match sentry's own pin files exactly.
# Each exact pin gets its own pkg-group: a group resolves to a single
# catalog revision, and these two versions do not co-exist in one.
python313.pkg-path = "python313"
python313.version = "python3-3.13.1"       # .python-version
python313.pkg-group = "python"
nodejs_24.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"
nodejs_24.version = "24.14.0"              # .node-version + devenv/config.ini
nodejs_24.pkg-group = "node"

# Python package manager. Brewfile: brew 'uv'; lockfile is uv.lock.
# pnpm is NOT installed here — package.json pins pnpm@10.30.2 exactly,
# and corepack (bundled with nodejs_24) provisions that precise version.
uv.pkg-path = "uv"

# Brewfile: required for `pnpm test -u`. Also in devenv/post_fetch.py
# REQUIRED_APT_PKGS, so it is required on Linux too.
watchman.pkg-path = "watchman"

# Brewfile: the docker CLI is used by some make targets and by devservices.
# docker-client is CLI-only — the daemon still comes from Docker Desktop
# (or your Linux docker service), matching the Brewfile's own comment.
docker-client.pkg-path = "docker-client"
docker-buildx.pkg-path = "docker-buildx"

# Acceptance testing. devenv/post_fetch.py lists chromium-chromedriver in
# REQUIRED_APT_PKGS for Linux only; on macOS devenv/sync.py downloads a
# chromedriver matched to your installed Google Chrome instead. The catalog
# package is Linux-only, which lines up with that split.
chromedriver.pkg-path = "chromedriver"
chromedriver.systems = ["x86_64-linux", "aarch64-linux"]

# Shared libraries for prebuilt manylinux wheels. Nothing in uv.lock is
# compiled from source (every dependency ships a wheel), so these are not
# build inputs — they are load-time deps the wheels expect from the system:
#   psycopg2-binary -> libz.so.1        (zlib)
#   grpcio          -> libstdc++.so.6   (gcc-unwrapped's "lib" output)
# Linux-only: the macOS wheels link the OS-provided dylibs instead.
zlib.pkg-path = "zlib"
zlib.systems = ["x86_64-linux", "aarch64-linux"]
gcc-unwrapped.pkg-path = "gcc-unwrapped"
gcc-unwrapped.outputs = ["lib"]
gcc-unwrapped.systems = ["x86_64-linux", "aarch64-linux"]


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
[vars]
# Sentry's .envrc raises node's heap for rspack builds.
NODE_OPTIONS = "--max-old-space-size=4096"
# Keep uv on the Flox-provided interpreter rather than downloading its own.
UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS = "never"


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
##  Mirrors the dependency-i
